title: Accessible guidance and fine positioning
purpose: Turn routes and shelf observations into clear, interruptible spoken and haptic instructions, including fine positioning at the shelf.
architecturalScope: Guidance bounded context. GuidanceGenerator and FinePositioner. Consumes Navigation, Localization and Perception. Styles follow the Wayfindr audio wayfinding standard.
domainContext: GuidanceSession aggregate, NavigationInstruction, Distance, Heading, RelativePose. Emits NavigationPaused / NavigationResumed.

milestones.title: Coarse guidance templates
milestones.description: Deterministic spoken instructions for route steps.

milestones.title: Fine positioning dialogue
milestones.description: Confirmation-based left/right/level guidance at the shelf.

tasks.title: Adopt Wayfindr-style phrasing and a guidance template engine
acceptanceCriteria: Templates are data-driven and reviewable by accessibility testers.

tasks.title: Generate haptic patterns for direction and arrival
Implement fine positioning dialog
acceptanceCriteria: Horizontal hit rate > 80% on the test shelf.
Instructions degrade to questions when confidence is low.
Every instruction is understandable without any visual cue.
Long or time-critical instructions can be interrupted immediately.
Fine positioning never states a distance as fact unless measured.

risks.description: Speech output conflicts with the screen reader.
risks.mitigation: Explicit screenreader-guided vs app-guided modes with defined interruption rules.

safetyImplications: Guidance must never say 'you can go' or imply a guaranteed clear path.
accessibilityImplications: Guidance is the primary user-facing output and must be fully non-visual.
privacyImplications: No guidance transcripts are stored by default.
verificationRequirements: Haptic pattern comprehension test with users.

decisionLog.decision: MVP guidance subset lives in todo.spoken-guidance and todo.guidance-state-machine; this track covers later fine positioning and shelf guidance.
